purpose: Generate native Rust public contract values and an explicit asynchronous provider trait from a checked Interface.
requirements: Preserve Interface-local contract identities as distinct Rust structs.
Preserve scalar, domain value, optional, list, set, and sum types without Entity snapshot leakage.
Expose operations only as methods on an explicit provider trait.
Implement the declared consumer-to-provider version policy without numeric coercion.
Do not generate transport, server, dispatch, invariant execution, or member execution.
